notes: Complete partition: 20 source ids and 22 target ids, each once, across 19 units.

ἦσαν and προσκαρτεροῦντες are joined because the ASV wrote one English verb phrase for the periphrasis, *continued stedfastly* glossing προσκαρτερέω whole; splitting it would put *stedfastly* on a token it does not gloss. Both competing readings — the split and an `unrepresented` ἦσαν — are named in the unit's note.
ὁμοθυμαδόν heads on *accord*, the word answering to the compound's core, not on the ὁμο- element (rules 17 and 66).
τῇ before προσευχῇ is `unrepresented` for want of a determiner, so *in prayer* is one unit on the noun (rules 21 and 23); τοῖς before ἀδελφοῖς is emptied by the expressed αὐτοῦ (rule 20).
The three variant units are all satisfied by the projection's readings; none engages rule 97.
